articles.summary: FidoCure is AI-driven precision medicine for canine cancer care. Our advanced platform uses a vast clinico-genomic database to provide personalized, data-backed treatment options that improve outcomes, reduce side effects, and offer hope for dogs battling cancer.
articles.title: AI-Driven Cancer Care

articles.summary: Introducing Fetch™, FidoCure’s AI engine that analyzes 2 billion data points to optimize personalized cancer therapies for dogs, transforming canine cancer treatment with unprecedented precision.
articles.title: Introducing Fetch™: Our AI Engine That Optimizes Cancer Therapies for Dogs
